Class Projectile

java.lang.Object
model.common.Projectile
All Implemented Interfaces:
Collidable, Renderable, Updatable
public class Projectile extends Object implements Updatable, Renderable, Collidable
Represents a moving projectile fired by the player or enemies. Supports piercing (hitting multiple targets) and tracks which targets have been hit.

  • Constructor Details

    • Projectile

      public Projectile(double damage, Vec2 position, Vec2 velocity, String imagePath, double width, double height, int piercesLeft, boolean fromPlayer)
      Constructs a new projectile with the given properties.
      Parameters:
      damage - damage dealt on hit
      position - initial position
      velocity - velocity vector in units per second
      imagePath - path to sprite image
      width - projectile width in pixels
      height - projectile height in pixels
      piercesLeft - number of enemies this can pierce through
      fromPlayer - true if fired by player, false if fired by enemy

      public boolean registerHit(Object target)
      Records that this projectile has hit the given target. Prevents the same piercing projectile from multi-hitting the same enemy in one frame.
